visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with several finished shrimp seaweed rolls displayed on a white plate in an extreme close-up shot, showcasing the dark, crispy seaweed exterior and the vibrant filling of yellow corn and white shrimp paste, garnished with white sesame seeds. (2) A person's hands are shown in a top-down view, adding bright yellow corn kernels, orange carrot bits, and chopped green onions into a large glass mixing bowl filled with white shrimp paste using a pink spatula. (3) The chef adds a clear liquid from a small bowl followed by white powdered seasonings into the bowl, then uses the spatula to mix all the colorful ingredients thoroughly into a uniform paste. (4) The mixed paste is then scooped and transferred into a clear plastic piping bag, with the pink spatula visible against the wooden tabletop surface in the background. (5) A square sheet of dark roasted seaweed is folded in half twice by the hands, and then carefully torn along the created creases to produce four smaller square seaweed pieces. (6) A thick line of the prepared shrimp mixture is piped along one edge of a seaweed square; the hands then roll the seaweed tightly around the filling, using a touch of water to seal the edge. (7) In a dark non-stick frying pan, oil is poured and then wiped evenly across the surface with a white paper towel before several seaweed rolls are placed inside and turned using metal tongs. (8) After the rolls sizzle briefly, a clear glass lid is placed over the pan to steam-cook the rolls; a male chef in a white professional jacket with short dark hair appears, standing before a white brick wall and talking to the camera while holding the tongs. (9) In a small glass bowl, a white creamy sauce and yellow mustard are combined and stirred with a silver spoon until smooth and uniform. (10) The chef sprinkles white sesame seeds over the rolls on a white plate, concluding with high-angle close-up shots of the final appetizing dish.
